## Changes Made

### 1. CS0433 fix — `PublicApiIntegrationTests` ambiguous `Program` type

**Root cause**: `PublicApiIntegrationTests.csproj` referenced both `PublicApi` and `Web`. Both expose a top-level `Program` class (`PublicApi/Program.cs` via an explicit `public partial class Program {}` stub; `Web/Program.cs` via the implicit class generated by top-level statements). The compiler saw two `Program` types in scope when compiling `ProgramTest.cs`.

**Fix**: Assigned an extern alias (`WebRef`) to the `Web` project reference so its `Program` type is no longer injected into the global namespace.

**File**: `tests/PublicApiIntegrationTests/PublicApiIntegrationTests.csproj`
```xml
<!-- Before -->
<ProjectReference Include="..\..\src\Web\Web.csproj" />

<!-- After -->
<ProjectReference Include="..\..\src\Web\Web.csproj">
  <Aliases>WebRef</Aliases>
</ProjectReference>
```

**File**: `tests/PublicApiIntegrationTests/CatalogItemEndpoints/CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint.cs`

Added `extern alias WebRef;` declaration and updated the `using` for Web ViewModels to use the aliased namespace:
```csharp
// Before
using Microsoft.eShopWeb.Web.ViewModels;

// After
extern alias WebRef;
using WebRef::Microsoft.eShopWeb.Web.ViewModels;
```

---

### 2. xUnit2013 warning fixes — use `Assert.Single`/`Assert.Empty`

The xUnit2013 analyzer flags `Assert.Equal(0/1, collection.Count)` as incorrect; the proper assertions are `Assert.Empty` and `Assert.Single`.

**File**: `tests/UnitTests/ApplicationCore/Specifications/CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification.cs`
```csharp
// Line ~22 — Before
Assert.Equal(1, result.OrderItems.Count);
// After
Assert.Single(result.OrderItems);

// Line ~35 — Before
Assert.Equal(1, result[0].OrderItems.Count);
// After
Assert.Single(result[0].OrderItems);
```

**File**: `tests/UnitTests/ApplicationCore/Entities/BasketTests/BasketRemoveEmptyItems.cs`
```csharp
// Before
Assert.Equal(0, basket.Items.Count);
// After
Assert.Empty(basket.Items);
```

**File**: `tests/IntegrationTests/Repositories/BasketRepositoryTests/SetQuantities.cs`
```csharp
// Before
Assert.Equal(0, basket.Items.Count);
// After
Assert.Empty(basket.Items);
```
